title: Display full precision of all decimals in st.dataframe() instead of default 4 decimal limit
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Default st.dataframe() beheviour is only displaying 4 decimals, and then you have to double click on the cell to actual see if it has more decimals to it. 
The pandas dataframe is rounded and might show inaccurate number depending on your desires.
What I've found in my situation is that I want the actual precison as if I viewed the data in a speadsheet.




### Why?

I desired in many cases to have full decimal presion when showing number in a st.dataframe()

### How?
```python
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd

def show_dataframe_with_full_decimal_presion(df):
    column_config = {
        col: st.column_config.NumberColumn(col, format="%f")
        for col in df.select_dtypes(include="number").columns
    }
    st.data_editor(df, column_config=column_config)

# Sample DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "item": ["A", "B", "C", "D"],
    "value": [123.456, 78.1234567, 45.1, 12.0],
    "otherValue": [1.22323123123, 3.456789, 7.0, 0.0001234],
    "role": ["x", "z", "k", "j"]
})


# show with defaul streamlit behavior

st.header("default dataframe limited to 4 deimals")
st.dataframe(df)

st.header("full presision")
show_dataframe_with_full_decimal_presion(df)
```
### Additional Context

It could be awesome to have a option:
st.dataframe(myDf, full_decimal_precision=true) 

Its the equvilient of displaying a regular pandas dataframe in st.dataframe() and then press the "3 dots" near the column header, choosing "format" and choosing "plain"

Closing this since its possible via `format="plain"` in `st.column_config.NumberColumn` or `st.column_config.NumberColumn(col, format="%f")` shown in the snippet above. We don't plan to add another dataframe wide option to make this configurable.
